@graph.name: Food Waste Paper Similarity Knowledge Graph
@graph.description: Pipeline for analyzing 30 research papers on food waste. Extracts structured data via Grobid (XML), enriches metadata with ORCID, Wikidata and OpenAlex APIs, computes semantic similarity scores and topic modeling (BERTopic + KeyBERT), and builds a Knowledge Graph in Turtle format.
@graph.keywords: food waste, knowledge graph, topic modeling, semantic similarity, BERTopic, Grobid, ORCID, Wikidata, OpenAlex, RDF, Turtle

@graph.name: pygrobid module
@graph.description: Sends PDFs to Grobid API and collects structured XML output

@graph.name: Input PDFs
@graph.description: 30 research papers on food waste in PDF format (paper0.pdf … paper29.pdf)

@graph.name: OpenAlex enrichment output
@graph.description: JSON files with enriched paper metadata from OpenAlex (24 papers matched)

@graph.name: pyextractdata module
@graph.description: Parses Grobid XML and extracts abstracts, DOIs, authors, acknowledgements and builds initial Knowledge Graph

@graph.name: Knowledge Graph (Turtle)
@graph.description: Initial RDF Knowledge Graph with paper metadata, authors and organizations in Turtle format

@graph.name: pyorcid module
@graph.description: Queries the ORCID API to enrich author metadata for papers where ORCID IDs are available

@graph.name: pywikidata module
@graph.description: Queries Wikidata SPARQL endpoint to enrich organization metadata linked to paper authors

@graph.name: pyopenalex module
@graph.description: Queries OpenAlex API by DOI or title to enrich paper metadata (citation count, keywords, open_alex_id)

@graph.name: pyclustering module
@graph.description: Computes semantic similarity between paper abstracts using sentence-transformers and cosine similarity. Performs topic modeling with BERTopic (UMAP + HDBSCAN) and generates human-readable topic labels with KeyBERT.
